description: `headerRow` names the row of column names and keys every row by them. `display` reads the values as a person sees them rather than as they are stored. `filter` keeps rows, `offset` and `limit` page what is kept, and `mapper` decides what each one becomes.
The order is fixed: filter, then offset, then limit, then mapper — so a limit counts matching rows, not rows read.
